mapper.sql: f.id AS fieldId, f.field_code AS fieldCode, f.field_kind AS fieldKind, f.field_label AS fieldLabel, f.component_type AS componentType, f.dict_type AS dictType, f.options_json AS optionsJson, f.section_code AS sectionCode, f.locked AS locked, tf.id AS templateFieldId, COALESCE(tf.enabled, f.default_enabled) AS enabled, COALESCE(tf.required, f.default_required) AS required, COALESCE(tf.list_visible, 0) AS listVisible, COALESCE(tf.list_sortable, 0) AS listSortable, COALESCE(tf.commonly_used, 0) AS commonlyUsed, tf.display_label AS displayLabel, COALESCE(tf.sort_order, f.sort_order) AS sortOrder
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_biz_form_field f LEFT JOIN crm_biz_form_template_field tf ON tf.field_id = f.id AND tf.template_id = #{templateId} AND tf.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND tf.del_flag = 0 WHERE f.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND f.del_flag = 0 AND f.object_type = (SELECT object_type FROM crm_biz_form_template WHERE id = #{templateId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1) ORDER BY COALESCE(tf.sort_order, f.sort_order) ASC, f.id ASC

SELECT FROM crm_biz_form_field f INNER JOIN crm_biz_form_template_field tf ON tf.field_id = f.id AND tf.template_id = #{templateId} AND tf.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND tf.del_flag = 0 WHERE f.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND f.del_flag = 0 AND tf.enabled = 1 ORDER BY tf.sort_order ASC, f.id ASC

SELECT id, tenant_id, object_type, field_code, field_kind, field_label, component_type, dict_type, options_json, section_code, locked, default_enabled, default_required, sort_order, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag FROM crm_biz_form_field WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND object_type = #{objectType} AND LOWER(field_code) = LOWER(#{fieldCode}) AND del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1
